=== Report === "men men...E1M2 lahti aika tasasissa merkeissa kayntii ja vaikka era pelattiinkin jossain huitsin nevadassa niin pelaamaankin pysty jotenkin, vaikkakin buumarilla oli vahan hankala osuu pingista johtuen. Kumpikaa ei oikein tuntunyt saavan mappia haltuunsa, kunnes sitte meikan kone taas yllattaen kaatu. No takasin niin nopeesti kun paasee, mutta kun ei paassy kovin nopeesti kun en valokuvamuistiltani muistanu serverin ip:ta. Harmin paikka sinansa oltas voitu tama ehka voittaakkin, mutta ei ainakaa talla kertaa. DM2n oli sitten jo sinetoity ennen alusta kun meilla piti ottaa Tuke pelaamaan. Ihan hyvin pystyttiin alussa kuitenkin laittaan hantti, tosin quad-water-alatele sektio oli FF:lla koko matsin ajan. Jossain 10min kohalla seco hyppas tuken tilalle pelaan ja saatiinkin heti kavennettua eroa johonkin 30fragii? No ilo oli kuitenkin aika lyhytaikanen, FF valtas quad alueen takas ja alko pitaan viela alarl sen verta tehokkaasti etta ei jakoja. No pitaa ottaa revanssii joskus..."
- Report by Lastu Google Translation:
"I'm going...E1M2 opened with pretty even marks, and even though the game was played somewhere in Huitzin Nevada, I was still able to play somehow, although boomer had a hard time hitting the wax due to the ping. Neither of them really seemed to be able to get hold of the map, until then the makeup machine unexpectedly crashed again Well, I was back as fast as it was, but it wasn't very fast because I couldn't remember the server from my photo memory. It's a pity that you won't be able to win, but DM2 was already sealed before the start , during the whole match. At about 10 minutes, seco jumped in to play and the gap was narrowed to something like 30fragii? Well, it was nice however, it's pretty short-lived, FF is overpowering the quad area and I'm still holding it down effectively so there's no splits. Well, I'll have to take revenge sometime..."
